is_recoverable.instructions: Can this pw.x failure be addressed by one of the supported numerical actions? Consult state.problem_catalog and this input history. Memory failures are recoverable only when the current settings admit one of the bounded memory reductions; do not assume every crash is SCF failure.

criteria.true: A supported numerical action has satisfied preconditions and has not already failed.
criteria.false: Input, geometry, pseudopotential, restart, storage, library or MPI problem; unexplained crash; or no applicable numerical remedy remains.

strategy.instructions: Use state.problem_catalog for diagnosis and source context. Select only a strategy listed here and in the executable actions. Check current_input and previous_remediation_history; never choose a no-op or repeat a failed edit. Do not change the physical model or accuracy targets. When a catalog entry requires manual review and no supported numerical remedy applies, select abort.

criteria.switch_diagonalization_cg: Persistent late-step c_bands or cdiaghg/rdiaghg failure with sensible geometry and pseudopotentials, or Davidson memory pressure. Try cg once if not already selected; it is slower. Early eigenvector warnings alone do not justify a change.
criteria.reduce_mixing_beta: Estimated SCF accuracy is oscillating or plateaus due to charge sloshing in the spinor density.
criteria.switch_mixing_mode_local_tf: Charge sloshing in an inhomogeneous system; require evidence QE >= 7.3 before choosing local-TF. With unknown/older version use reduce_mixing_beta or manual upgrade instead.
criteria.increase_maxstep: SCF error is decreasing monotonically but ran out of iterations before reaching conv_thr.
criteria.abort: Manual-review problem, unknown cause, missing action preconditions, unchanged parameter, or exhausted supported remedies. Do not retry the same ineffective edit.
criteria.increase_mixing_history: Persistent SCF oscillations after gentler mixing; current mixing_ndim < 12 (absent means 8), with available RAM and no memory failure. Set history to 12 once.
criteria.reduce_mixing_history_memory: Memory allocation failure associated with density mixing and mixing_ndim > 4 (absent means 8). Set to 4 once; do not increase history during memory failures.
criteria.reduce_davidson_workspace: Davidson workspace memory pressure with diago_david_ndim explicitly greater than 2. Set to 2 once; not useful when already 2 or when diagonalization is cg.

needs_remediation.instructions: Review this input and its own history. Suggest changes only when evidence supports them; do not assume a universal convergence threshold, smearing width, or mixing mode.

criteria.true: This input has a documented convergence problem in its own prior history and an available numerical remedy.
criteria.false: No input-specific evidence supports a proactive change.

strategy.instructions: Use state.problem_catalog, current input and its own history. Apply only supported actions whose preconditions are satisfied; otherwise select none. No universal best settings are assumed.

criteria.reduce_mixing_beta: Prior history supports gentler density mixing; halve the current value within the action bounds.
criteria.switch_mixing_mode_local_tf: Charge sloshing in an inhomogeneous system; require evidence QE >= 7.3 before choosing local-TF. With unknown/older version use reduce_mixing_beta or manual upgrade instead.
criteria.increase_maxstep: Prior history shows decreasing residual stopped at electron_maxstep; add 100 iterations only if more steps are justified.
criteria.none: All parameters look optimal based on prior history; no further proactive edits needed.

research.scope: pw.x electronic convergence and related diagnostics; forum advice is conditional and version dependent. Numeric remedy values are bounded workflow choices, not universal convergence guarantees.

problem_catalog.solution: Try mixing_ndim=12 with spare memory; avoid repeatedly undoing a memory reduction.
Reduce mixing_ndim to 4 only if larger; scheduler-killed jobs may need more allocated RAM.
Reduce explicit diago_david_ndim > 2 to 2; consider cg.
Check structure and pseudopotentials; cg is conditional, never a cure for overlapping atoms.
Upgrade to QE >= 7.3; unknown version is insufficient evidence to enable local-TF.
Early warnings alone need no remedy; investigate persistent final-step warnings.
Check magnitude; significant USPP density artifacts can require ecutrho convergence tests.
Check outdir permissions, quota, capacity, restart integrity and concurrent prefix collisions.
Check electron count, bands and broadening; consider Gaussian/cold smearing after reviewing occupations.

signals: charge is wrong: smearing is needed
problem_catalog.solution: Review occupation treatment and empty bands; validate smearing against the intended system.
Check restart compatibility; preserve data before planning a fresh start.
Check pseudopotential functional consistency; do not force an XC override automatically.
Match relativistic pseudopotentials to the intended SOC calculation; do not toggle the physical model automatically.
Check force/energy consistency and electronic tolerance; relaxing conv_thr can worsen ionic convergence.
A historical developer report found diago_david_ndim=2 helpful; verify version and cause before applying.
Inspect runtime diagnostics, dependencies and resource allocation before changing SCF parameters.
